67. The appeal is dismissed being devoid of merits.
The judgment and decree of the Ld Trial Court dated 04.07.2016 is upheld.

The connected appeals bearing no.225/16 by Vicky Paints and Chemicals Vs. Haryana Financial Corporation and Ors. and 237/2016 by Murti Devi Vs. Haryana Financial Corporation and Ors. are also dismissed by this order.
No other pending application in the appeal was pressed for.
All pending applications if any, are disposed off in terms of the present judgment.
